### 版本能力汇总 / Release highlights

- **Beta.6 新增：** 加固和独立签名新增按应用分享选择，新包名默认选中，同包名取消后在两页和下次启动保持；成功后发送应用名称、包名、应用版本码、工具版本、操作、流程、成功日期及提交/协议/说明版本信息，仅维护者可见、保留 180 天。不上传 APK、路径、证书、密码或设备标识；独立于匿名统计开关，取消不删除已接收记录，接收需服务端单独启用 / **New in Beta.6:** Per-app sharing for successful protection and standalone signing is selected by default for new package names, with opt-outs retained across both pages and restarts. Reports contain app name, package name, version code, tool version, operation, flow, success date, and submission/schema/notice metadata. Maintainer-only access, 180-day retention; no APK, paths, certificates, passwords, or device identifiers. Independent of anonymous metrics; opting out does not delete previously received reports, and server-side enablement is required

- 修复非 UTF-8 Java 环境下中文证书 Alias 识别乱码及校验失败：统一 keytool 输出编码，无效编码不再作为别名保存；已有乱码记录请使用原证书重新识别或导入，无需重建密钥 / Fixed garbled Chinese certificate aliases and validation failures in non-UTF-8 Java environments by enforcing UTF-8 keytool output; re-detect or re-import existing garbled entries using the original keystore without recreating keys

- 标准模式支持逐次确认排除 APK 中不需要的旧 ABI；保留架构的壳库完整性检查不变，原始 APK 不受影响 / Standard mode now supports explicit per-task exclusion of unsupported ABIs while preserving runtime completeness checks and leaving the original APK unchanged

- 重组 APK 加固页面：输出文件名、保存目录与低频设置分区展示，并持久化常用加固方案 / Reorganized the protection page with dedicated output controls, grouped low-frequency settings, and persisted protection defaults
- 增加加固前风险检查：识别签名、已加固载荷、DEX、ABI、`minSdkVersion`、`extractNativeLibs`、split APK 与 Android 共享库兼容信号 / Added preflight checks for signatures, existing payloads, DEX, ABIs, `minSdkVersion`, `extractNativeLibs`, split APKs, and Android shared-library compatibility signals
- 直接只读解析 APK 二进制 Manifest，不依赖 apktool 或资源展开；单独选择 split APK 会明确阻止 / Added direct read-only binary Manifest parsing without apktool or resource extraction; standalone split APKs are explicitly blocked
- 增加可复制的脱敏加固诊断摘要，不包含路径、证书、密码、包名、业务类名或原始错误文本 / Added copyable sanitized protection diagnostics that exclude paths, certificates, passwords, package names, business class names, and raw error text
- 根据 APK 最低 SDK 提示标准模式与 Android 4.4 工控兼容模式的适用范围，不自动改变用户选择 / Added `minSdkVersion`-based guidance for standard and Android 4.4 industrial compatibility modes without changing the user's selection automatically
- 匿名桌面统计增加按版本聚合的固定失败类别；可逐次确认发送安全错误报告，先预览再发送，不上传原始日志、APK、路径、包名、证书或密码；报告接收须服务端启用 / Added version-specific failure categories to opt-out desktop metrics and per-report consent with a full preview; reports exclude raw logs, APKs, paths, package names, certificates, and passwords, and require the reporting service to be enabled
- 兼容内容实际为 JPEG、扩展名却为 `.png` 的普通资源；仅无损改名为 `.jpg`，九宫格资源和命名冲突保持失败关闭 / Added compatibility for ordinary resources containing JPEG data with a `.png` extension through lossless renaming to `.jpg`; nine-patch resources and naming conflicts remain fail-closed

- 修复系统生成 `oat/` 优化目录后被误判为 DEX 缓存失效的问题，清理缓存时不跟随目录符号链接 / Fixed DEX cache invalidation caused by ART-generated `oat/` directories; cache cleanup no longer follows directory symlinks

1.4.0 正式版沿用 Beta.6 的功能实现，不追加新能力。缓存修复需要重新加固并签名 APK 才能生效；请验证首次启动、强制停止后多次启动和覆盖安装。暂不包含批量加固、生产级内存 DEX 或直接 AAB 加固。

The 1.4.0 stable release retains Beta.6 functionality without additional features. Re-protect and sign your APK to apply the cache fix, then test initial launch, repeated launches after force-stop, and upgrade installation. Batch protection, production in-memory DEX loading, and direct AAB protection are not included.

已知问题：部分 Fedora 环境下 AppImage 可能出现空白窗口，尚未定位，见 [#121](https://github.com/mocikadev/mocika-shield/issues/121)。三平台构建通过不等同于所有系统环境实测通过；遇到问题请附版本、环境和脱敏日志反馈，后续通过 1.4.x 修复版处理。

Known issue: AppImage may display a blank window on some Fedora environments; investigation remains open in [#121](https://github.com/mocikadev/mocika-shield/issues/121). Successful builds do not establish runtime compatibility with every environment. Please report the version, environment, and sanitized logs; fixes will follow in 1.4.x patch releases.
